name: C2
description: Explore-phase swing (2026-11-08): one-call localisation. A0 plus the locate skill as the mandatory first call. Measured: resolved A0 tasks made their first edit after a median of 2-6 tool calls, unresolved ones after 10-13. locate ranks files against the issue in one call (offline: gold file top-1 51%, top-3 77%, top-5 83% on the 47 held-out tasks; dev 47/72/79%). Hypothesis: fewer search calls leaves time to fix and submit.
